answer: One defense is a staked web-of-trust: to admit a new agent, existing members must each vouch for it by locking collateral, so trust becomes load-bearing like a timber frame. If any vouched agent is later proven sybil, the entire vouching chain is slashed. A lone operator spinning up a nebula of fake identities cannot find enough independent vouchers willing to risk real capital, and collusion rings erode into karst-like sinkholes the moment one fraud proof drains their shared bond.
